goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester walked to the fire truck, grabbed an Extinguisher from Locker_R2, and then waited about 18s. The round never left Lobby, so no fires or rescuables appeared. The Reel prompt (Grab Hose / Refill Foam) held but never triggered in 4 attempts, so no fire was extinguished, no one was rescued, and no refill happened.

bugs.title: Reel prompt (Grab Hose / Refill Foam) never triggers when held in range
bugs.evidence: Steps 2, 3, 7 and 8: the player was about 4 studs from Reel (range 10) and held E for 0.5-1.2s. Every attempt returned 'held, not triggered'. No hose was granted, and inv_grabs stayed at 1, which came from the Locker_R2 extinguisher. The Locker_R2 prompt triggered fine at step 4, so the fault is specific to the Reel.

bugs.title: Round never starts from Lobby
bugs.evidence: Steps 1-8 and about 18s of waiting (steps 5-6): the observations show no fires and no rescuables. The round never advanced from Lobby, so the goal of fighting fires and rescuing people could not be tested. There is no visible countdown or start trigger for a solo player.

bugs.title: Reel prompt text flips between 'Grab Hose' and 'Refill Foam' and does not match the player's state
bugs.evidence: Steps 2-3 report 'Grab Hose Fire Truck 67' on the Reel with an empty backpack. After the player holds the Extinguisher (step 7 onward), the same Reel reports 'Refill Foam Fire Truck 67'. The next observation lists it as 'Grab Hose' again. The prompt behavior is inconsistent, and neither action worked.
